roots.origin: 拉丁语 hostis（外来者，引申为敌）与 hospes（主/客）同出原始印欧语 *ghos-ti-（外来人）；同一个「门外来人」在善意一支成 hospes（待客），在敌意一支成 hostis（对敌）
roots.core_concept: the outsider at the door, received or resisted / 门外来人，或迎或拒
roots.core_image: 一扇门前站着外来人：开门递茶是一支，横身挡道是另一支
roots.english_definition: stranger at the door, guest, enemy

roots.origin: 拉丁语 cernere（筛、分开、看出分别），本义是拿筛子把杂物分开
roots.core_concept: to sift things apart until each shows clear / 筛开混杂，直到各自分明
roots.core_image: 手里的筛子一摇，砂石落下，留在网上的粒粒分明

roots.origin: 拉丁语 levare（举起、减轻），来自 levis（轻的）：使变轻即托得起来
roots.core_concept: to raise a load by making it light / 把重物托起、使之变轻
roots.core_image: 一头垫住石块，另一头轻轻下压，沉物就离了地

roots.origin: 希腊语 Mousa（缪斯，司文艺的九女神）经拉丁语 musa 入英语；mousike techne（缪斯的技艺）本指诗歌与声律合一的技艺
roots.core_concept: the ordered sound the Muses grant / 缪斯所赐、合于法度的声响技艺
roots.core_image: 琴弦被拨动，一串声响按着法度次第流出

roots.origin: 拉丁语 ars（属格 artis：手上练出的本事、门道），与 artus（关节、接合）同源，本义偏「把东西接合安排得当的手艺」
roots.core_concept: skill of the trained hand, arranging things aright / 练出来的手上功夫，把物事安排得当
roots.core_image: 一双练过千遍的手，把零散材料摆布成让人挪不开眼的东西

roots.origin: 拉丁语 ordo（属格 ordinis：行列、次序），本指织机上排开的经线，引申为凡物各就其位的排布
roots.core_concept: each thing standing in its own place in a row / 各就各位、排成一列
roots.core_image: 一列物件按高矮排开，谁也不越出自己那格

roots.origin: 拉丁语 origo（属格 originis：发端、出处），来自 oriri（升起、涌出），与 oriens（东方，日升之处）同根
roots.core_concept: the point where something first rises up / 事物最初涌出来的那一处
roots.core_image: 顺溪流一路上溯，走到山间那眼往上冒水的泉口

roots.origin: 拉丁语 pangere（钉入、固定、缔结），过去分词 pactus；把桩钉牢即定下约，故 pactum 表协议，compingere/impingere 表拼合与撞入
roots.core_concept: to drive a thing fast in place, hence to fix an agreement / 把物钉牢固定，引申为定下约
roots.core_image: 木桩被一锤锤钉进土里，钉牢了就再也挪不动

concepts.concept: the outsider at the door, received or resisted
concepts.core_image: 门前立着外来人，或请进或挡住，两条路分出两支词

concepts.concept: to sift apart until each thing shows clear
concepts.core_image: 筛子一摇，杂物落尽，留下的粒粒看得分明

concepts.concept: to raise a load by making it light
concepts.core_image: 一压一撬，沉甸甸的石头就离了地面

concepts.concept: the ordered sound the Muses grant
concepts.core_image: 指尖拨过琴弦，声响依法度次第流出

concepts.concept: the trained hand's skill in arranging things aright
concepts.core_image: 练过千遍的手，把零散材料摆布成挪不开眼的东西

concepts.concept: each thing standing in its own place in a row
concepts.core_image: 一列物件按高矮排开，谁也不越出自己那格

concepts.concept: the point where something first rises up
concepts.core_image: 溯流而上，尽头是那眼往上冒水的泉口

concepts.concept: to drive a thing fast in place, hence to settle an accord
concepts.core_image: 木桩一锤锤钉进土里，钉牢便再挪不动

words.root_logic: hospes（主/客）一支 → 开门接纳来者、张罗招待的那一方
words.origin: 古法语 hoste，来自拉丁语 hospes（主人与客人同词），与 hostis 同源
words.native_definition: a person who receives and entertains guests; also a large number of things
words.core_concept: the one who takes in whoever arrives and sees to them – 接纳来者并一手张罗的那方
words.core_image: 门一开，来者被让进屋，茶已经斟在桌上
examples: The host welcomed every guest at the door.
A host of problems followed the storm.
semantic_expansions: 主人/主持人：接纳来者并张罗招待的一方
大量：如同一屋子挤满来客，多到成群
words.recall_hint: hospes（主/客）→ 开门接纳来者的那一方

words.root_logic: hoste（客）+ -age → 留在对方手里的「客」，实为被扣下作抵的人
words.origin: 古法语 ostage（寄居、抵押），来自 hoste（客），源头同 hospes/hostis
words.native_definition: a person held captive as security until demands are met
words.core_concept: a guest turned pledge, kept until terms are met – 由客转为抵押，扣着等对方应条件
words.core_image: 旅人被留在营中不得走，成了对方开条件的凭据
examples: The gunmen held three hostages inside.
He was taken hostage on the border.
semantic_expansions: 人质：被扣下充作抵押的来人
words.recall_hint: hoste（客）+ -age → 被扣在对方手里充抵的来人

words.root_logic: host（主人）+ -ess（阴性）→ 出面招待来客的女性一方
words.origin: 英语 hostess，host 加阴性后缀 -ess
words.native_definition: a woman who receives and entertains guests
words.core_concept: the woman who takes in arrivals and sees to them – 出面接纳并招待来者的女方
words.core_image: 她举杯招呼满屋来客，一张张桌子都照看过来
examples: The hostess showed us to our seats.
She works as an air hostess.
semantic_expansions: 女主人/女主持人：出面接纳并招待来者的女方
words.recall_hint: host（招待方）+ -ess（阴性）→ 出面招待来者的女方

words.root_logic: hostis（外来者→对头）+ -ile → 摆出对头架势的
words.origin: 拉丁语 hostilis（属于 hostis 的），来自 hostis（外来者、对头）
words.native_definition: unfriendly and aggressive; showing strong opposition
words.core_concept: wearing the temper of the one barred at the door – 摆出门口横身挡道那种架势
words.core_image: 来者脸色不善，话里透着要开仗的意思
examples: The crowd turned hostile within minutes.
They faced hostile questions all evening.
semantic_expansions: 敌意的/敌对的：摆出挡道对峙的那副架势
words.recall_hint: hostis（门外对头）+ -ile → 摆出对峙架势的

words.root_logic: con-（一并）+ cern（筛分）→ 一并筛进来跟自己有牵连 → 牵动心思
words.origin: 拉丁语 concernere（混在一起筛、相关），来自 con＋cernere
words.native_definition: to be about something, or to make someone anxious; such anxiety
words.core_concept: being sifted into the same pile as a matter, so it weighs on one – 被筛进同一堆里，事情便挂在心上
words.core_image: 消息传来，他一夜没合眼，反复过着那桩事
examples: This rule concerns everyone in the building.
Her silence caused real concern.
semantic_expansions: 涉及：被筛进同一堆、与之有牵连
关心/担忧：牵连到自己，于是挂在心上
words.recall_hint: con-（一并）+ cern（筛分）→ 被筛进同一堆 → 有牵连、挂心上

words.root_logic: concern（牵涉）的分词转介词 → 就所牵涉的那件事而言
words.origin: 英语 concerning，concern 的现在分词转作介词
words.native_definition: about; with reference to a particular matter
words.core_concept: pointing at the very pile a matter was sifted into – 直指某事被归进的那一堆
words.core_image: 信里逐条写的，都紧扣那笔款的来龙去脉
examples: He asked several questions concerning the delay.
We had no news concerning her whereabouts.
semantic_expansions: 关于/有关：就所牵涉的那一桩而言
words.recall_hint: concern（牵涉）+ -ing → 就所牵涉的那桩而言

words.root_logic: dis-（分开）+ cern（筛分）→ 一层层筛开，直到看出分别
words.origin: 拉丁语 discernere（区分开来），来自 dis＋cernere
words.native_definition: to recognize or make out something with effort
words.core_concept: sifting the layers apart until the thing stands out – 层层筛开，直到那物凸显出来
words.core_image: 隔着晨雾眯眼细看，岸上那道影子终于显出轮廓
examples: She could just discern a figure in the fog.
It is hard to discern his true motive.
semantic_expansions: 辨别/认出：筛开混杂后把那物分出来
洞悉：筛到底层、连内里也看出来
words.recall_hint: dis-（分开）+ cern（筛分）→ 筛开层层，看出分别

words.root_logic: lev（举起）+ -er（工具）→ 用来把重物撬起来的那根杆
words.origin: 古法语 levier（撬棒），来自 lever（举起）← 拉丁语 levare
words.native_definition: a bar used to prise something up; a means of exerting pressure
words.core_concept: the bar that raises a weight far heavier than the hand pressing it – 以小力撬起远重于手劲之物的杆
words.core_image: 长杆一头垫住石块，另一头轻轻下压，巨石离地
examples: He used an iron bar as a lever.
Tax breaks became a political lever.
semantic_expansions: 杠杆：以小力撬起重物的那根杆
手段：像撬杆一样能撬动局面的着力处
words.recall_hint: lev（举起）+ -er（工具）→ 撬起重物的那根杆

words.root_logic: lev（举起）→ 把款项或人手「举」起收拢到官府手里
words.origin: 古法语 levee（收取、征集），来自 lever（举起）← 拉丁语 levare
words.native_definition: to impose and collect a tax or troops; the amount so raised
words.core_concept: raising a sum or a body of men out of the populace – 从民间把银钱或人手举收上来
words.core_image: 官府张榜，按册向各户收取银钱
examples: The council levied a new charge on parking.
A levy was placed on imported goods.
semantic_expansions: 征收/税款：从民间举收上来的银钱
征募：同样手法举收人手入伍
words.recall_hint: lev（举起）→ 从民间举收银钱或人手

words.root_logic: re-（回）+ lev（举起）+ -ant → 能把话题重新托举起来的 → 搭得上
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 relevans（托起、有助于），来自 relevare（再举起）
words.native_definition: closely connected with the matter being discussed
words.core_concept: able to lift the matter at hand rather than hang off it – 托得起眼下这桩事，而非旁挂
words.core_image: 他提的两点正落在会上要议的那桩事上
examples: Please bring any relevant paperwork.
That remark was hardly relevant here.
semantic_expansions: 相关的/切题的：托得起眼下这桩事、搭得上
words.recall_hint: re-（回）+ lev（举起）→ 把眼下话题托举得起 → 搭得上

words.root_logic: mus（缪斯）+ -ic（…的技艺）→ 缪斯所司的声律技艺
words.origin: 希腊语 mousike（缪斯的技艺）经拉丁语 musica、古法语 musique 入英语
words.native_definition: sounds arranged in a pleasing or ordered way
words.core_concept: sound set in order so the ear follows it – 把声响排布成序，耳朵便跟得上
words.core_image: 琴弦一拨，满室的说话声就静了下来
examples: She has listened to this music all week.
The music grew louder as we entered.
semantic_expansions: 音乐/乐曲：排布成序、耳朵跟得上的声响
words.recall_hint: mus（缪斯）+ -ic → 缪斯所司的声律技艺

words.root_logic: music（声律技艺）+ -al（…的）→ 属于声律的、听着顺耳的
words.origin: 英语 musical，music 加形容词后缀 -al
words.native_definition: relating to sound arranged in order; pleasant to hear
words.core_concept: belonging to ordered sound, so it falls kindly on the ear – 属于有序声响，故听来顺耳
words.core_image: 这孩子开口一唱，调子准得让人侧耳
examples: He comes from a musical family.
She spoke in a soft, musical voice.
semantic_expansions: 音乐的：属于声律技艺的
悦耳的：合于法度，听来顺耳
words.recall_hint: music（声律）+ -al → 属于声律的、听来顺耳

words.root_logic: music（声律技艺）+ -ian（司此业者）→ 以声律技艺为业的人
words.origin: 古法语 musicien，来自拉丁语 musicus（通声律者）
words.native_definition: a person who plays or writes music, especially as a job
words.core_concept: one whose craft is ordered sound – 以有序声响为业的人
words.core_image: 台上几人调好弦，静候指挥落棒
examples: The musician tuned her violin.
He became a professional musician at twenty.
semantic_expansions: 音乐家/乐手：以声律技艺为业的人
words.recall_hint: music（声律）+ -ian（司此业者）→ 以声律为业的人

words.root_logic: ars（手上本事）→ 练出来的门道，及其做出的作品
words.origin: 古法语 art，来自拉丁语 ars/artis（手艺、门道）
words.native_definition: the making of things meant to be looked at or admired; a learned skill
words.core_concept: what the trained hand brings forth, and the knack behind it – 练过的手所成之物，及其中门道
words.core_image: 画布上一笔一笔堆出光影，看的人半晌没说话
examples: She studied art for four years.
There is an art to asking good questions.
semantic_expansions: 艺术/美术：练出的手所成、供人观览之物
技艺：做成此物背后的那套门道
words.recall_hint: ars（手上练出的本事）→ 门道，及其做出的作品

words.root_logic: art（手艺）+ -ist（司此业者）→ 以这门手上功夫为业的人
words.origin: 法语 artiste，来自中世纪拉丁语 artista（通艺者）← ars
words.native_definition: a person who makes paintings, sculpture, or other such works
words.core_concept: one whose trade is the trained hand's making – 以练出的手做东西为业的人
words.core_image: 他在阁楼里对着画架站了一整天，颜料蹭到袖口
examples: The artist worked in oils and charcoal.
She is a well-known artist in this city.
semantic_expansions: 艺术家/画家：以练出的手做东西为业的人
words.recall_hint: art（手艺）+ -ist（司此业者）→ 以此手艺为业的人

words.root_logic: artist（司艺者）+ -ic（…的）→ 见得出手上门道的、有讲究的
words.origin: 英语 artistic，artist 加形容词后缀 -ic
words.native_definition: showing skill and taste in making or arranging things
words.core_concept: bearing the mark of a trained hand's judgement – 带着练过的手那份分寸
words.core_image: 这只陶碗的弧线收得讲究，摆上桌就压住了满桌俗气
examples: The room had an artistic arrangement of flowers.
He has real artistic talent.
semantic_expansions: 艺术的/有美感的：带着练过的手那份分寸与讲究
words.recall_hint: artist（司艺者）+ -ic → 见得出手上门道的、有讲究的

words.root_logic: ordo（行列）→ 各就其位的排布；由「排定」引申为排定要办之事、要买之货
words.origin: 古法语 ordre，来自拉丁语 ordo/ordinis（行列、次序）
words.native_definition: the way things are arranged; an instruction to do something; a request for goods
words.core_concept: things standing each in its place, and the word that puts them there – 各就其位的排布，以及使其就位的那句话
words.core_image: 书脊按高矮一列排开，谁也不越位；掌事的一句话下来，各人照着做
examples: Please put the files back in order.
The captain ordered them to wait.
semantic_expansions: 顺序/秩序：各就其位的那个排布
命令：使各人就位去办的那句话
订单：把要买之货排定下来
words.recall_hint: ordo（行列）→ 各就其位；使之就位便是发话与排定

words.root_logic: dis-（离散）+ order（各就其位）→ 位次散了 → 乱；身体位次乱了即病症
words.origin: 法语 désordre（无秩序），dis-＋ordre ← 拉丁语 ordo
words.native_definition: a state of confusion; also an illness that upsets normal function
words.core_concept: the row broken up, nothing standing where it should – 行列散开，无一物在该在的位上
words.core_image: 抽屉被翻得底朝天，东西全不在原处
examples: The room was left in complete disorder.
He suffers from a sleep disorder.
semantic_expansions: 混乱：行列散开、无物在其位
失调/疾病：身体各处的位次乱了
words.recall_hint: dis-（离散）+ order（就位）→ 位次散乱

words.root_logic: order（各就其位）+ -ly（…样的）→ 一眼看去各在其位的
words.origin: 英语 orderly，order 加后缀 -ly
words.native_definition: neatly arranged; behaving in a controlled way
words.core_concept: keeping the row unbroken, each in place – 行列不散，各守其位
words.core_image: 队伍一列列排开，间距分毫不差
examples: They formed an orderly queue at the gate.
She keeps an orderly desk.
semantic_expansions: 整齐的/有条理的：行列不散、各守其位
words.recall_hint: order（就位）+ -ly → 各在其位、看去不散

words.root_logic: origo（涌出之处）→ 事物最初冒出来的那一处，及人的出处
words.origin: 法语 origine，来自拉丁语 origo/originis（发端）← oriri（升起）
words.native_definition: the point or cause from which something begins; a person's ancestry
words.core_concept: the spot where a thing first rises into being – 那物最初冒出来的那一处
words.core_image: 顺着溪流一路上溯，直到山间那眼冒水的泉口
examples: The origin of the fire is still unknown.
She is proud of her humble origins.
semantic_expansions: 起源/起点：事物最初涌出的那一处
出身：人所从来的那一处
words.recall_hint: origo（涌出之处）→ 最初冒出来的那一点

words.root_logic: origin（发端）+ -al（…的）→ 处在最初那一处的；也指头一份实物
words.origin: 古法语 original，来自拉丁语 originalis（属于发端的）
words.native_definition: existing from the start; new and not copied; the first version of a thing
words.core_concept: standing at the rising point, before any copy – 立在涌出那一处，尚无摹本
words.core_image: 抽屉里那张手稿是头一份，后来的都照着它抄
examples: The house keeps its original windows.
Please send me the original, not a copy.
semantic_expansions: 最初的：立在发端那一处的
原创的：从自己那处涌出、非摹自他人
原件：头一份实物，摹本之前的那个
words.recall_hint: origin（发端）+ -al → 处在最初那一处、尚无摹本

words.root_logic: origin（发端）+ -ate（使…）→ 自某处涌出、由某处发端
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 originare（发端于），来自 origo
words.native_definition: to begin in a particular place or from a particular cause
words.core_concept: to come rising out of a given spot – 自某一处冒出来
words.core_image: 这条河的水，是从那道石缝里第一次涌出来的
examples: The custom originated in southern Spain.
The idea originated with her, not him.
semantic_expansions: 起源于/发源：自某处涌出来
创始：使某物从自己这处涌出
words.recall_hint: origin（发端）+ -ate → 自某处涌出来

words.root_logic: pactum（已钉牢之事）→ 双方钉定下来的约
words.origin: 拉丁语 pactum（协议），pacisci（缔约）的过去分词，源于 pangere（钉牢）
words.native_definition: a formal agreement between two or more sides
words.core_concept: the terms driven fast so neither side may shift them – 条款被钉牢，两边都不得再挪
words.core_image: 两方在纸上各按一个手印，从此照纸上写的办
examples: The two nations signed a trade pact.
They made a pact never to speak of it.
semantic_expansions: 协定/条约：被钉牢、双方不得再挪的约
words.recall_hint: pactum（钉牢之事）→ 双方钉定下来的约

words.root_logic: com-（一起）+ pact（钉合）→ 各部分钉合在一起、不占地方的
words.origin: 拉丁语 compactus，compingere（拼合钉牢）的过去分词，来自 com＋pangere
words.native_definition: closely packed into a small space; neatly small
words.core_concept: parts driven together so no gap is left – 各部分钉合到一处，不留空隙
words.core_image: 行李被压得严丝合缝，箱盖一扣还有余地
examples: The flat has a compact kitchen.
Snow was compact underfoot.
